name: Uso o Hitotsu Dake
source:
The story is about a 16 year old girl named Haruna Raika, who is in the hospital and is destined to die before she’s 20. One day an angel comes through her hospital room window saying she will die tomorrow. Before she kicks the bucket, he says he will make one of her lies come true, but it may only affect the destiny of one person.

[Edited from [url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2011/08/24/otome-game-review-uso-wo-hitotsu-dake/]Hinano's Game Babbles[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述的是一位名叫Haruna Raika的16岁女孩，她在医院里，注定会在20岁之前死去。有一天，一位天使从她病房的窗户进来，告诉她明天就会死去。在她临终前，他说他会让她的一个谎言成真，但这可能只会影响一个人的命运。

[编辑自[url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2011/08/24/otome-game-review-uso-wo-hitotsu-dake/]日野的游戏胡言乱语[/url]]
